All done. Here's what was implemented in `ringbuf.c`:

- **`rb_create`** — allocates the struct + backing buffer, rejects capacity==0
- **`rb_destroy`** — frees both buffers, accepts NULL
- **`rb_write`** — writes bytes respecting the circular boundary, clamps to free space, returns actual count written
- **`rb_read`** — reads oldest-first with wrap-around support
- **`rb_peek`** — copies oldest bytes without removing them
- **`rb_size` / `rb_capacity` / `rb_clear`** — utility accessors/combiners

Compiles cleanly with `-std=c11 -Wall -WError`, all 29 tests pass including wrap-around ordering and edge cases.
